final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS a FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_a FROM r WHERE a IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.rating, r.a AS avg_ratio, r.a - m.mean_a AS above_mean FROM r, m WHERE m.mean_a IS NOT NULL AND r.a > m.mean_a
